product_overview: HabitGrow is a gamified habit tracker that helps users build consistency through daily habit tracking, XP, streaks, achievements, and a virtual tree that visually grows with progress. It also includes analytics, a calendar heatmap, and predictive nudges to keep users engaged with their habits.
core_goals: Track and complete scheduled habits daily
Earn XP and build streaks through consistent completion
See progress reflected in consistency scores and virtual tree growth
View habit history and performance statistics
Unlock achievements as habit milestones are reached
Receive predictive nudges for habits at risk of being missed
Use the app comfortably across mobile and desktop devices

features.name: User Login & Authentication
features.description: Users can sign in with email and password to access their protected habit dashboard and app sections.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an error message
Open a protected app page without a session -> Be redirected to /login

features.name: Habit Management
features.description: Users can create, view, filter, archive, restore, edit, and delete their habits from the habits page.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/habits -> Open the habit creation flow -> Enter habit details including name, category, icon, color, frequency, and target -> Save the habit -> See the new habit in the list
Navigate to /app/habits -> Filter habits by category or archived status -> See the habit list update
Navigate to /app/habits -> Archive an active habit -> See the habit move out of the active list
Navigate to /app/habits -> Restore an archived habit -> See the habit return to the active list

features.name: Daily Habit Completion
features.description: Users can mark scheduled habits as complete and receive immediate gamified feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/dashboard -> Review today's scheduled habits -> Mark a habit complete -> See confetti and the habit card update to a completed state
Navigate to /app/dashboard -> Review today's scheduled habits -> Mark another scheduled habit complete -> See XP and streak progress reflected in the interface

features.name: Predictive Habit Nudge
features.description: Users can view a risk alert for habits that may be missed and apply a one-click target adjustment.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/dashboard -> Review the predictive nudge alert for a habit at risk -> Accept the suggested adjustment -> See the habit target update
Navigate to /app/dashboard -> Review the predictive nudge alert -> Leave it unchanged -> Continue using the dashboard

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Users can view a main summary of today’s habits, streak, level, XP, tree preview, weekly progress, and recent achievements.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/dashboard -> View today's habits, streak, level, XP, and tree preview -> Use the dashboard as the main daily hub
Navigate to /app/dashboard -> Review recent achievements and weekly progress -> Continue to a habit action from the dashboard

features.name: Virtual Tree Progression
features.description: Users can monitor a virtual tree whose stage and health reflect their consistency score.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/tree -> View the current tree stage and health -> Observe the consistency score and growth roadmap
Navigate to /app/tree -> Improve habit consistency through completions -> Return later and see the tree advance to a higher stage

features.name: Calendar Heatmap & Day Inspector
features.description: Users can inspect a year of habit activity through a GitHub-style contribution heatmap and detailed day view.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/calendar -> View the yearly activity heatmap and yearly totals -> Select a date in the calendar -> See the day inspector with completion details
Navigate to /app/calendar -> Switch between yearly and monthly views -> Review activity patterns across the year

features.name: Statistics & Analytics
features.description: Users can review daily, weekly, and monthly performance charts, consistency trends, and habit performance summaries.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/statistics -> Review completion charts and consistency trends -> Compare daily, weekly, and monthly performance
Navigate to /app/statistics -> Review best and worst habit performance -> Use the analytics to understand habit trends

features.name: Achievements
features.description: Users can view unlocked and locked achievements and track progress toward milestones.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/achievements -> Review achievement badges and milestone progress -> See which achievements are unlocked and which are still in progress
Navigate to /app/achievements -> Continue completing habits -> Return later and see new achievements unlocked

features.name: Profile Settings & Preferences
features.description: Users can update profile information and personal preferences such as display name, avatar, timezone, and theme.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/profile -> Update display name or avatar -> Save changes -> See the updated profile information
Navigate to /app/profile -> Change preferences such as timezone or theme -> Save changes -> Continue using the app with updated settings

features.name: Mobile Responsive Navigation
features.description: Users can move through the app with a bottom navigation bar and slide-over drawer that adapts to mobile use.
user_flows: Use the bottom navigation bar to move between the main app sections -> Open the menu drawer -> Choose another destination -> See the selected page
Navigate on mobile -> Switch between light and dark theme -> See the theme update across the interface

routes.description: Main executive dashboard with streak, level, virtual tree, predictive nudge, and habit hub
Habit management list, category filter, active and archived tabs, create habit modal
Virtual tree sanctuary showing tree stage, health percentage, consistency score, and growth roadmap
Botanical GitHub-style 52-week activity contribution heatmap, annual statistics, and day inspector
User performance analytics, charts, completion distribution, and consistency trends
User profile settings, display name, and preferences

features.name: User Login & Authentication
features.description: Secure email and password login flow powered by Supabase Auth
user_interactions: Fill email input field
Fill password input field
Click Masuk button to authenticate
See error banner on invalid credentials
Redirect to /app/dashboard upon successful authentication

features.name: Habit Checklist & Optimistic Execution
features.description: Instant 0ms checklist with tactile circular button, confetti burst, and automatic streak and XP calculation
user_interactions: View today scheduled habit items
Click circular check button to mark habit complete
Observe celebratory confetti particle explosion
See habit card transition to completed style with strike-through and XP reward badge

features.name: Habit Management (CRUD)
features.description: Create, edit, archive, restore, and delete habits with customizable icons, colors, targets, and schedules
user_interactions: Click Tambah Kebiasaan button to open creation modal
Fill habit name, category, icon, color, frequency, and target
Click Simpan Kebiasaan to create habit
Filter habits by category or archive status
Archive or restore habits

features.name: Decision Support System (DSS) SAW Predictive Churn Nudge
features.description: 5-criteria Simple Additive Weighting (SAW) calculating churn vulnerability with 1-click adaptive adjustment
user_interactions: View smart predictive nudge alert when habit is at risk
Review recommended adaptive target adjustment
Click 1-click action button to adaptively update habit target

features.name: Mobile Responsive Navigation & Drawer
features.description: Ergonomic bottom navigation bar and slide-over hamburger drawer with safe-area support
user_interactions: Tap bottom bar tabs (Beranda, Kebiasaan, Pohon, Kalender, Menu)
Tap Menu to open slide-over drawer navigation
Tap close button or backdrop to dismiss drawer
Switch theme between Light and Dark mode
